selector.rationale: Elevated CK, troponin I, myoglobin, and LDH with reduced plasma protein and albumin, along with muscle biopsy demonstrating interstitial and perivascular T-cell and macrophage infiltrates, support rhabdomyolysis as the primary diagnosis.

rejected.label: Myocarditis
rejected.why: Although cardiac MRI confirmed myocarditis, it is considered a secondary complication in this context.

rejected.label: Myelitis
rejected.why: Spinal MRI demonstrated a hyperintense lesion concerning for myelitis, but it is not the primary diagnosis explaining the patient's overall condition.
